name: oh-my-openagent
tagline_zh: 代码库太乱？Codex 常迷路？这个 harness 让 agent 像老员工一样熟门熟路，专治复杂仓库。
tagline_en: Lost in a messy repo? This harness gives your Codex/OpenCode the map—complex codebases, fewer tokens, more done.
desc_en: omo/lazycodex: The coding agent for tokenmaxxers;the one and only agent harness for complex codebases. For your Codex, for your OpenCode
why_zh: 它用上下文压缩和路径预索引，让 agent 少翻文件、多写代码，比同类省 30% token。
why_en: Pre-indexes paths and compresses context, so agents code more and search less—saves ~30% tokens vs. similar tools.
